map.输入消费金额与小费比例（或按服务档次预设），计算小费金额、含小费总额及多人分摊后: Enter the bill amount and tip percentage (or pick a service-level preset) to get the tip amount, the total including tip and the per-person share, with support for different currencies and group sizes. Useful for estimating gratuities when dining abroad.
map.出国就餐前，按当地小费习惯（比例或固定）算应付小费、含小费总额及多人分摊，避免现: Before dining abroad, compute the tip, the total and the per-person share following local tipping custom, so you can avoid miscalculating on the spot.
map.团建/聚餐 AA 时，把小费摊进人均，直接报每人应付，减少扯皮。: For team gatherings or shared meals, fold the tip into the per-person amount and quote it directly to avoid arguments.
map.对比「按比例」与「按服务档次预设」两种给法，选符合当地惯例又不显得吝啬的金额。: Compare the percentage method with the service-level preset to pick an amount that fits local custom without looking stingy.
map.：小费=金额×比例=800×15%=120 元；含小费总额=800+120=92: Tip = amount × rate = 800×15% = 120; total including tip = 800+120 = 920; per person = 920/4 = 230. At a local norm of 18%: tip = 144, total = 944, per person = 236. When switching currencies, convert the amount to the local currency at the rate of the day before computing, to avoid a currency mismatch.
map.各国小费比例多少？: What are the tipping rates in different countries?
map.美国堂食 15-20%（服务好取高）、酒吧约 1-2 美元/杯；日本/韩国通常不: In the United States, 15-20% at a sit-down restaurant, taking the higher end for good service, and about 1-2 dollars per drink at a bar; Japan and Korea usually do not tip; European restaurant bills often include service (look for "service compris") and rounding up is enough. Follow the custom of your destination; this tool only does the arithmetic and does not advise on etiquette.
map.已经收了服务费还要给吗？: Should I still tip when a service charge is already added?
map.账单标注「服务费已含/service charge」时一般不必另给；若服务特别好: When the bill says service is included or shows a service charge, extra tipping is generally unnecessary, though you may leave a little for excellent service. The tip here is computed independently from the rate you enter, so whether to add it on top is your judgement.
